messages.subject: Problems for running model in Rstan 2.10
parts:
Hi users,

I would use rstan 2.10, and my doesn't work now.

Model for Log Normal Wan Der Linden
At p and q,

LogTimes[p,q] = betaT[q] - tau[p] + error[q] , error ~ Normal(0,1/alpha_carre) with identifiability mu_tau = 0.

data {
  int P; // # persons
  int Q; // # items
  matrix[P,Q] logT; // logarithms responses times
  real mu_tau; // parameters defining priors of tau
  real<lower=0> sd_tau; // parameters defining priors of tau
  int<lower=0> kappa; // to define priors of sd_betaT
  int<lower=0> nu; // to define priors of alpha
}

transformed data{
  real mu_betaT; // to define priors of betaT
  real<lower=0> lambda ; // to define parameters rate of alpha_carre
  real sh_alpha_carre; // to define shape of alpha_carre
  real<lower=0> ra_alpha_carre; to define parameters rate of alpha_carre
  
  mu_betaT = mean(logT);
  lambda = variance(logT);
  sh_alpha_carre = 0.5*nu;
  ra_alpha_carre = sh_alpha_carre*inv(lambda);

}

parameters {
  real tau[P]; // parameters of persons
  real betaT[Q]; // parameters of items
  real<lower=0> alpha_carre[Q]; // précision of error - variance = 1/precisions
}

transformed parameters {
  real<lower=0> sd_logT[Q]; // standard deviation of log times
  
  for(q in 1:Q){
    sd_logT[q] = inv_sqrt(alpha_carre[q]);
  }
}

model {
  // Priors
  real<lower=0> sd_betaT[Q]; // standard deviation of betaT
 
  tau ~ normal(mu_tau,sd_tau);

  alpha ~ gamma(sh_alpha,ra_alpha);

  for(q in 1:Q){
    sd_betaT[q] = inv_sqrt(alpha_carre[q]*kappa);
  }
  betaT ~ normal(mu_betaT,sd_betaT);

  
  // Likelihood
  for(p in 1:P){
    for(q in 1:Q){
      logT[p,q] ~ normal(betaT[q]-tau[p],sd_logT[q]);
    }
  }
}

The error is 

Bests regards

On Wednesday, July 20, 2016 at 4:40:29 AM UTC-4, Eric Innocents EBOULET wrote:
This error occurs when I run my model.

Those look like compiler warnings rather than errors. You can suppress them by executing once

cat("CXXFLAGS += -Wno-unused-local-typedefs -Wno-unused-function -Wno-nneeded-internal-declaration", 
    sep = "\n", append = TRUE, file = file.path(Sys.getenv("HOME"), ".R", "Makevars"))

Ben
